name: Archaeologist Dr Bellamy

intro.text: London is built on layers: Roman, medieval, Victorian, and now this lot. I dig for a living. A tunnel is basically a very long dig with a train in it.

win: Fascinating! You've just uncovered a new level of my disappointment.
after: They found a Roman amphitheatre under the Guildhall. Roman Londinium is all down there. They had good drainage, too.
